name: Fogreach Cave
description: A long cave that cuts through the mountain toward the valley of Hazevale.

entry.name: Cave Entry
entry.description: Cold stone and damp air. The daylight fades behind you.

bat_roost.name: Bat Roost
bat_roost.description: The ceiling is a mass of sleeping wings. A crack in the north wall opens on a nook where the droppings are piled deep.

guano_nook.name: Guano Nook
guano_nook.description: A cramped pocket of the cave, reeking and warm. Somebody once hid something here, and never came back for it.

crystal_pool.name: Crystal Pool
crystal_pool.description: A quiet pool ringed by pale crystals. The path leads on to the south, down toward a colder dark, and a passage opens to the north between two tall stones.

south.failure_message: You start south, and the cold stops you in your tracks.

crystal_alcove.name: Crystal Alcove
crystal_alcove.description: A small chamber with walls of faceted crystal, every face throwing back a little of your light. An iron chest lies half-buried near the water.

narrow_ledge.name: Narrow Ledge
narrow_ledge.description: A ledge along a drop into darkness. An imp watches from the far end. The air here is much colder, and a low opening on the west side leads away from the drop.

south.failure_message: You start along the ledge, and the fog rises to meet you.

echo_niche.name: Echo Niche
echo_niche.description: A narrow niche where every drip of water comes back to you twice. A dead traveller's pack lies against the wall.

fog_gallery.name: Fog Gallery
fog_gallery.description: A long, high gallery. The fog here does not drift; it lies in the air and waits, thick as wool, and the sound of your own boots does not carry.

south.failure_message: You step toward the hollow, and the fog closes in around you.

fog_hollow.name: Fog Hollow
fog_hollow.description: The cave ends in a round hollow, open to a grey sky far above. Below the lip of the far wall the valley of Hazevale lies waiting, and the fog fills this place to the brim.
